import math
import unittest

from solution import MatrixCatalog, MatrixKind


class MatrixCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_enum_and_full_catalog_independence(self):
        self.assertEqual(MatrixKind.DENSE.value, "dense")
        vectors = [[1, 2.5], [3, 4]]
        classes = [("a",), ("b",)]
        catalog = MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE, vectors, classes)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.vectors, vectors)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.classes, classes)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.width, 2)
        self.assertIsNot(catalog.vectors, vectors)
        self.assertIsNot(catalog.vectors[0], vectors[0])
        self.assertIsNot(catalog.classes, classes)
        vectors[0][0] = 99
        classes[0] = ("changed",)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.vectors[0], [1, 2.5])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.classes[0], ("a",))
        catalog.vectors[1][0] = -1
        self.assertEqual(vectors[1], [3, 4])

    def test_selection_order_empty_selection_and_width(self):
        vectors = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
        classes = ["b", "a", "b"]
        selected = ["b"]
        catalog = MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE, vectors, classes, selected)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.vectors, [[1, 2], [5, 6]])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.classes, ["b", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.width, 2)
        empty = MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE, vectors, classes, [])
        self.assertEqual(empty.vectors, [])
        self.assertEqual(empty.classes, [])
        self.assertEqual(empty.width, 2)

    def test_empty_dataset_and_read_only_width(self):
        catalog = MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE, [], [])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.width, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            catalog.width = 4

    def test_required_arguments_use_normal_python_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            MatrixCatalog(MatrixKind.DENSE, [])

    def test_invalid_values(self):
        cases = [
            ("dense", [[1]], ["a"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, (), [], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [], (), None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1]], [], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[]], ["a"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1], [2, 3]], ["a", "b"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[True]], ["a"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[math.inf]], ["a"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[math.nan]], ["a"], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1]], [[]], None),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1]], ["a"], ("a",)),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1]], ["a"], ["a", "a"]),
            (MatrixKind.DENSE, [[1]], ["a"], [["a"]]),
        ]
        for kind, vectors, classes, selected in cases:
            with self.subTest(kind=kind, vectors=vectors, classes=classes, selected=selected):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    MatrixCatalog(kind, vectors, classes, selected)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
